newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian bourse delists expired loan stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian bourse delists expired loan stocks.

text.p: Ten industrial loan stocks which expired between 1995 and last year were delisted from the official list of the Nigerian stock market on Friday.
An official of the bourse said their removal would help portray a clear picture of outstanding loans in the market.
"The market capitalisation of the industrial loans sector is also down as a result but it has no negative impact as the stocks have reached their maturity," the official added.
The current market capitalisation for the industrial loans sector was not immediately available.
For equities, the market capitalisation on Thursday was 284.4 billion naira.
The official said more industrial loan stocks were likely to be listed this year. "It is preferred to bank loans and payment is just twice a year," he said.
